intro: Iraq has over 45 million people, most of them Arabs, with a large Kurdish population in the north.

chapters.title: Peoples and faiths
text: Arabs make up most of the population and Kurds perhaps a fifth; there are also Turkmen, Assyrians, Yazidis and other groups. Arabic and Kurdish are both official.
Most Iraqis are Muslim, with Shia Muslims the majority and a large Sunni minority. The holy cities of Najaf and Karbala draw millions of Shia pilgrims.

chapters.title: A young country
text: Iraq's population is young and growing fast. Baghdad, Basra, Mosul and Erbil are the largest cities.

keyTerms.meaning: A religious minority mainly in northern Iraq.
